description_en: Queries the distribution of request source ISPs for an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance within a specified time period
description_zh: 查询指定时间段内DDoS高防实例的请求来源运营商分布
name: DescribePortViewSourceIsps

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the request data to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

The value must be on the minute
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的请求数据的结束时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒。

必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the request data to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

The value must be on the minute
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的请求数据的开始时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒。

必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表
parameters.name: instance_ids

Isps.description_en: The request source ISP information of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
Isps.description_zh: DDoS高防实例的请求来源运营商信息

Count.description_en:
The relative number of requests.

This value does not represent the actual number of requests. You can use this value to calculate the proportion of requests from different ISPs
Count.description_zh:
相对请求数量。

该数据不表示真实请求数量的大小，目前您可以使用该数据来计算不同运营商请求数量的比例

IspId.description_en: The ISP ID. For more information, see the ISP code table below the response parameters. The ISP ID corresponds to the code in the table
IspId.description_zh: 运营商ID。详见返回参数表下的运营商代码说明，运营商ID对应表中的代码
